queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:abt__ut2_mv_vendor_blocks( company_id INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', block_id INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', position INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', status CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A', snow_title CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N', PRIMARY KEY (company_id, block_id) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:abt__ut2_mv_vendor_custom_metadata` ( company_id INT(11) NOT NULL, lang_code CHAR(2) NOT NULL, page VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (company_id, lang_code,page, name) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
